room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day or Single Private AC Room
room_rent.note: Higher of 1% of base SI per day or single private AC room (most economical); proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Optional 'Any Room Upgrade' add-on allows any room except suite.

icu.note: 2% of base SI per day OR actual ICU/ICCU expenses OR at actuals up to SI; no proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses when admitted to ICU

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional co-payment of 10% or 20% on every admissible claim can be opted at inception; once opted cannot be removed at renewal.

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹50k or ₹1L/eye; Genetic Disorder ₹1L; Advance Procedures 25% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹50,000 or ₹1,00,000 per eye per year (as per schedule); Genetic Disorder capped at ₹1,00,000; Advance Procedures (robotic, etc.) capped at 25% of SI; Internal Congenital Anomaly capped at 25% of SI; Major Illness Benefit capped at 100% of SI or ₹25L whichever lower.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional deductible can be chosen at inception only; does not apply to several covers like ambulance, cataract, advance procedures, etc.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents, COVID-19, Hypertension, Diabetes, Cardiac Conditions (90-day wait applies for those). Not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required; reduced to extent of prior coverage under portability/migration norms.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder, sinusitis, fibroids, etc. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Code-Excl 18. Ectopic pregnancy is also excluded. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 15% of basic SI added per claim-free year; reduces at same rate on a claim; max 100% of basic SI. Optional Enhanced Cumulative Bonus add-on increases rate to 25% or 50%/yr up to 200% of basic SI.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Refill: 100% of basic SI refilled once per policy year on complete or partial utilisation; available for all Section C.1 claims; single claim cannot exceed basic SI + cumulative bonus; refill not counted for cumulative bonus calculation.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover is 30 days or 60 days as specified in the Policy Schedule.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover is 60, 90, or 180 days as specified in the Policy Schedule.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of day-care procedures in Annexure II; all medically necessary day-care treatments covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to Sum Insured; several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, etc.).

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered up to SI for in-patient treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres within India.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered up to SI; donor's pre/post-hospitalisation and other consequential expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance limit is ₹3,000, ₹5,000, or ₹7,000 as specified in Policy Schedule; covers transfer to hospital, hospital-to-hospital, and hospital-to-home.

modern_treatments.note: Listed as 'Advance Procedures' (Section C.7) including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, etc.; capped at 25% of SI; co-payment does not apply to this cover.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded per Annexure III (gloves, masks, nebulisation kits, etc.). No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Treatment taken outside India is a specific exclusion (Section G.B.III). Domestic Emergency Assistance (including air ambulance) is available within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days grace period for monthly premium instalment; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies (not applicable for policies with tenure less than 1 year).

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, moratorium, no-claim bonus transferred.

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, OPD (except specific approved conditions), dental (unless inpatient), maternity, external congenital anomaly, circumcision (non-medical), vaccination
optional_riders: Hospital Cash, Major Illness Benefit (CI lump sum), Accidental Hospitalisation extra SI (1.5x/2x), Enhanced Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), No Claim Bonus Protector, Co-Payment, Any Room Upgrade, Deductible
